content:
Marcy's full pension after 40 years is $50,000 per year. She begins accruing pension benefits after 20 years of service at a rate of 5% of the full pension per additional year worked. 

If she quits after 30 years, she has worked 10 years beyond the initial 20 years. 
10 years × 5% per year = 50% of the full pension. 
50% of $50,000 = $25,000.

Answer: $25,000
